crossRefs.note: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat…
“I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in…
Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
and all ate the same spiritual food;
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s…
Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’ ”
Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.
For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.web: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
translations.bsb: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
translations.asv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by everything that proceedeth out of the mouth of Jehovah doth man live.
